message: **Four AI metric families gained a label value or a label.** `sbproxy_ai_toolkit_operations_total` adds the closed outcome `agent_failed`, which a customer agent rejecting or failing a call now records instead of `internal`; `sbproxy_ai_quality_routing_decisions_total` adds `prompt_too_large` for a prompt refused ahead of the quality hook; and the four chargeback tracker families carry an `origin` label naming the origin whose billing a refusal invalidated. Alerts that match on `outcome="internal"` or aggregate the chargeback families without `origin` need updating.
